yValueRange.description:
The minimum and maximum value of of all data points in {#seriesData}.
Used in the {@link SparePartsForecastChart}, for plotting now line adjusted to scale on the chart.

This is an array of size 2. With minimum value at index 0 and maximum value at index 1.

seriesData.description:
Map of series names to array of data points. Each data point is represented by a number. The data array
is aligned with the timestamps array.

For example:
```json
{
  'actualInventory': [2,3,4,NaN,NaN,NaN],
  'forecastedInventory': [NaN,NaN,NaN,5,6,7],
  'demandedInventory':  [NaN,NaN,NaN,6,8,9],
}
```

timestamps.description:
An array of stringified timestamps based on the interval and duration
of the spare parts forecast chart.

eventData.description: Map of {@link WorkOrder}s and {@link PurchaseOrder}. The key is 'workOrders' or 'purchaseOrders'.

thresholds.description:
Map of {@link InventorySeries#reorderLevel} and {@link InventorySeries#reorderQty}.
The keys are `reorderLevel` and `reorderQty`.

uom.description: Unit of measurement used to display on the Y-Axis of {@link SparePartsForecastChart}

title: This type stores all the data that will be shown in the Spare Parts Forecast Chart Per Part Chart in the UI.
name: SparePartsForecastChartData
